_help: Which Claude model each agent runs on. Edit, then run: python3 tools/set_models.py
Values: an alias (opus, sonnet, haiku, fable), 'inherit' (same model as the main session), or a full model ID such as claude-sonnet-5-5.
preset: picks the model for each tier below. Switch quickly with: python3 tools/set_models.py --preset budget
main_session: model for Meera (the main Claude Code session). null leaves your own Claude Code default alone.
tiers: which agents are 'strategic' or 'routine'. Every agent not listed is 'standard'.
overrides: per-agent model that beats the preset, e.g. {"cto": "claude-opus-5-5"}.
